exposure: Risk factors for intractable PPH (tachycardia, disseminated intravascular coagulation)
outcome: Success rate of TAE in controlling bleeding
cohort: The study included 301 women who experienced postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) between 2005 and 2013, focusing on 123 women with intractable PPH who underwent Transcatheter Arterial Embolization (TAE).
finding: Transcatheter arterial embolization (TAE) was a safe and effective first-line rescue treatment for intractable primary postpartum hemorrhage, demonstrating a high success rate and preservation of menstruation and fertility.
